snippet.title: Crown of Greed - Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
👑 Crown of Greed is an RTS with indirect control, deep meta progression, and a full 12-mission story campaign at launch.
Inspired by Slavic mythology and narrated by industry legend George Ledoux.

📅 Launching 31st March 2026
💰 Price: $19.99 USD 

👉 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1697870/Crown_of_Greed/

👑 Join our realm: https://discord.gg/qyY2FgmnMP

Music by: Ignacy Zalewski - https://www.ignacy-zalewski.com/
